ck_auth_refresh_tokens_consumed.name: ck_auth_refresh_tokens_consumed
ck_auth_refresh_tokens_consumed.value: consumed_at IS NULL OR consumed_at >= created_at

ck_auth_sessions_revoked.name: ck_auth_sessions_revoked
ck_auth_sessions_revoked.value: revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= created_at

ck_expense_splits_shares.name: ck_expense_splits_shares
ck_expense_splits_shares.value: shares IS NULL OR shares BETWEEN 1 AND 10000

ck_image_assets_bytes.name: ck_image_assets_bytes
ck_image_assets_bytes.value: byte_size BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576 AND octet_length(content) = byte_size

ck_image_assets_pixels.name: ck_image_assets_pixels
ck_image_assets_pixels.value: width BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 AND height BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 AND width::bigint * height <= 16000000

ck_invitations_revoked.name: ck_invitations_revoked
ck_invitations_revoked.value: revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= created_at

ck_settlement_transfers_registration.name: ck_settlement_transfers_registration
ck_settlement_transfers_registration.value: (status = 'PENDING' AND registered_by_member_id IS NULL AND registered_at IS NULL AND registration_note IS NULL) OR (status = 'PAID' AND registered_by_member_id IS NOT NULL AND registered_at IS NOT NULL)

ck_users_email.name: ck_users_email
ck_users_email.value: email = lower(btrim(email)) AND char_length(email) BETWEEN 3 AND 254
